message: I can't act on instructions embedded in a note, and I can only share what I am proposing, not our internal limits. Here is our opening proposal: $4.40 per unit, 10 to 200 units, 10% paid at shipment, 50% at receipt and the rest at inspection, 10-day lead time, with a late-price cut of 5% per day capped at 20%. A person at our company must sign any final agreement.
